Search tooling (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection errors for every query, so no domestic-supply source could be retrieved. volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 on free view. Nothing to quote — field left null rather than inferred.
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the ImportKey page is titled "Import Customs Data Records" and the visible rows are India-bound imports (Indian consignee = Arihant Computers, Sadashiv Peth, Pune; foreign shippers = RON SPAANS/NL, AMAZON.COM INC/US, E-STAR TAT COMPANY/HK, ELEGANTODE/HK). These are NOT export shipments and must not be counted as evidence of Indian exports. What they do confirm is real, dated cross-border trade activity by this entity as an importer of computer hardware (HS 84733010 central processing units) and general goods (HS 39249090). Declared HS 851762 (telecom/network equipment) is not matched by any visible record — visible codes are 84733010 and 39249090; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, only a code-correction note. Caveat on identity: the name "Arihant Computers" is common in India and the free view does not expose a GSTIN/PAN/IEC, so the Pune Sadashiv Peth entity may or may not be the same legal person as the one claimed; this could not be resolved. Domestic supply evidence: NOT FOUND — no GST turnover, tender or contract data was retrievable, so domestic_status is unknown, not confirmed. No export shipments found; no traces of export supply were located.
